Make the new app VIP reachable across the fabric.

+++ b/configs/leaf2.cfg
@@ -44,6 +44,13 @@
  router-id 10.255.2.12
  timers throttle spf 50 200 5000

 !
 ip route 10.102.99.0/24 null0
+ip route 10.102.50.0/24 10.102.1.10

text:
Note on the diff: the route-map matches `PL_VIP_LIST`, but the prefix-list defined is `PL_VIP`. A route-map that references a non-existent prefix-list typically matches nothing (or everything, depending on platform), so the redistribution may not work as intended. The tests below check that the VIP prefix actually propagates and that nothing else leaks.
